notes.title: Sign up for the beta!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260488/93bfad4be3cbd0a309f5dd6d1247323a7fc9cbab.gif[/img]

Soon! The beta test known as the West Clement Sanity Test will be available! This test is to create the platform for harsh criticism for the game, encouraging players to break the game as much as possible, and to test out story continuity.

There are 4 chapters in the game and Sanity Test will have chapter 1 & 2 to begin with, then soon after the first rounds of reactions and responses, chapter 3 will be available in the test. 

There will be at least 3 major updates to this test, other smaller/minor updates will be made when needed, like if the game build doesn't even start or something.

The exact date of the beta is not specific, but we will let you know when the specific date is announced!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260488/19da32c825968850ad7e784d58a192cd992b01f3.gif[/img]

One last thing to note: We have found out that the game has issues on Steam Deck (audio and UI control issues), so for the first round of testing, the game will be Windows only. The second round will have full Linux support.

notes.title: West Clement Info - #1: Introduction!
notes.notes:
[p]How West Clement Was Kinda Won will release soon, so to get you prepared for your trip to the fine town of West Clement, we will be giving nice little bits of info of the game. So let's get started!  [/p][h1]What is West Clement? What's up with it?[/h1][p]Placed right near the edge of Clement County, with Amberlight County to the west: West Clement is a town in the edge of the Great Plains U.S., in an area known as the Stow Province. It's a generally quaint town where it's people love to go outside and do a lot of nothing. It's citizens, mainly consisting of humans and zombies, are known to be quite lazy. 

A shock is felt by the entire community as it is found out that a company, an evil corporation, wants to tear down their city! 
These citizens will not let this happen to their town, so a group of four have formed a team to fight this evil corporation and this team is fierce. 
Backed up and supported by the other citizens of the town, the group calls themselves: The West Clement Resistance, and they are growing by the hour.

[/p][h1]Zombies?[/h1][p]Yes indeed, zombies make up a small percentage of the population and are non-existent outside of the province. I bet you are thinking: "Why isn't a bigger deal? These are zombies! They can take over the whole planet!!"
Surprisingly enough, the zombies in this area are easy to keep track of. There are two types of the main zombie here: A mostly human, functional zombie that is almost the same as the normal human but are just more carnivorous and requires more meat in their diet. At some point though, they turn into feral zombies. When completely feral, these ones are completely dependent on living flesh, no sort of humanity remains as they kill anything in sight. Turning feral can be slowed down or even stopped if one maintains a healthy lifestyle, like eating right.

As one can suspect with the info given, most of the functional zombies in West Clement may eventually turn feral. But worry not, there are feral zombie hunters that solve the problem when they turn!

[/p][h1]Stow Province?[/h1][p]Humans, Zombies, Robots, Aliens, and many other weird people live in this area. In 1994, aliens made their first contact with Earth and since then extraterrestrial aliens of different races and species live in this area. Mainly in the massive metropolitan area of the province, south of West Clement, a massive city named Garthsbrook. 

Ever since that day in 1994, nothing has been the same since. A company under the name of Non-Human Research (NHR) watches over the area closely and carefully. There is town just north-east of West Clement, named simply Clement, a very... interesting industrial town located in a forest near a lake.

To the straight west of West Clement is the area of Amberlight County. With large mountains and long stretches of plains, this place has the home of the main NHR building and is said to have many myths and legends surrounding the entire county!  [/p][p][/p][h1]Where do I come in all of this?[/h1][p]On a nice, cool early morning. A train arrives in West Clement at 5:00 AM, one of the first passenger trains to arrive in the area since 2009. Only one passenger steps out on this dimly lit morning. A drifter.
Right on time![/p][p][/p][h1]What do I do? What can I do?[/h1][p]Save West Clement, dummy! You slowly help the West Clement Resistance build their strength until the planned ultra-awesome-final-fight! Do stuff like: Recruit people, buy a massive inflatable gorilla, chip in for a pizza party, kick the butts of the rowdy enemy group known as The Headbangers, legitimately prove the existence of aliens, solve a mystery in the terrifying town of Clement, etc, etc...[/p][p]In fights, use abilities that you thought you never had![/p][p]Strengthen up by progressing through the game and winning in fights to earn money and items![/p][p]Heal your lost health and power points by eating and drinking stuff from familiar foods and drinks like many different slices of pizza, bottles and cans of soda, fruits and snacks - all the way to odd foods like popular dishes from different planets, medication that gives you extra protection, edible toilet paper, cans of energy drinks that actually shock you, and... werewolf steaks?...[/p][p][/p][h1]West Clement Info #1 Conclusion[/h1][p]Now that we have some of the story of the area written and some other misc stuff now public, up next we have the main gameplay loop + one of the many enemy factions + one of the companions to show next! This little series will go on for awhile, so you have something to look forward to!  [/p][p][/p][p]The game releases soon, we hope you stop by and see How West Clement Was Kinda Won![/p]
